paragraphs: Belden Inc. (the Company, us, we, or our) is a leading global supplier of complete connection solutions that unlock untold possibilities for our customers, their customers and the world. We advance ideas and technologies that enable a safer, smarter and more prosperous future. Throughout our 120-plus year history we have evolved as a company, but making connections remains our purpose. Our business is organized around two global businesses, Smart Infrastructure Solutions and Automation Solutions, both of which benefit from favorable secular trends which we expect to drive future growth. Each business represents a reportable segment. Financial information about our segments appears in Note 5 to the Consolidated Financial Statements. We sell our products to distributors, end-users, installers, and directly to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). Belden Inc. is a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1988, but the Company's roots date back to its founding by Joseph Belden in 1902.
As used herein, unless an operating segment is identified or the context otherwise requires, "Belden," the "Company", and "we" refer to Belden Inc. and its subsidiaries as a whole.

Our purpose is to make connections. Within Smart Infrastructure Solutions, our Smart Buildings products offer in-building wired and wireless infrastructures, fiber technology innovation, and design collaboration and customization to connect people with facilities through innovative solutions for enhanced human engagement, productivity, and security. Also within Smart Infrastructure Solutions, our Broadband Solutions products offer a broad portfolio of end-to-end solutions, industry-leading innovation and technology, and worldwide technical service and support to enable a connected, digital world through broadband and wireless innovation. Within Automation Solutions, we are uniquely positioned to support digital transformation by providing end-to-end digitization infrastructure focused on robust network infrastructure, secure remote access, accelerated convergence of information technology systems with operational technology (IT/OT), and edge and data analytics.

As of December 31, 2025, we operated our business under two segments – Smart Infrastructure Solutions and Automation Solutions. A discussion of the segments is included below. In 2026, we are realigning our organizational structure, moving to a unified functional operating model. See Note 25.

The Smart Infrastructure Solutions segment is a leading provider in network infrastructure and broadband solutions. Our priority vertical markets for our Smart Buildings Solutions include data centers, government, healthcare, and hospitality. We also serve customers in markets such as commercial real estate, education, financial institutions, stadiums and venues, and military installations. Our Broadband Solutions primarily serve broadband and wireless service providers. Smart Infrastructure Solutions product lines include copper cable and connectivity solutions, fiber cable and connectivity solutions, interconnect panels, racks and enclosures, and secure, high performance signal extension and matrix switching systems.

Smart Infrastructure Solutions provides true end-to-end fiber and copper network systems, which are used in applications such as local area networks, data centers, access control, 5G, Fiber to the Home, commercial audio/video, security and building automation. Our high-performance solutions support all networking protocols up to and including 100G+ Ethernet technologies. Our innovative products can deliver data in addition to power over Ethernet, which meets the higher performance requirements driven by the increasing number of connections in smart buildings. Smart Infrastructure Solutions products also include intelligent power, cooling, and airflow management for mission-critical data center operations. The product portfolio is designed to support Internet Protocol convergence, the increased use of wireless communications, and cloud-based data centers by our customers.

The Automation Solutions segment at Belden provides digitization and automation solutions as building blocks to enable IT/OT convergence, including physical AI, in demanding vertical markets. This enables our customers to make data-based business decisions. We accelerate digital transformation by providing complete connection solutions that cover the four aspects of data handling: acquisition, transmission, orchestration and management. Our primary markets include Warehousing & Logistics, Energy, Transportation and Discrete Manufacturing.

We help customers increase uptime and ensure network data availability, integrity and confidentiality. We understand the operational, quality, safety and innovation demands of our customers and empower them to succeed by making the most of real-time operational data. Our global team of engineers and consultants at our Customer Innovation Centers works directly with customers to understand operational issues, anticipate what successful outcomes require and solve unique networking needs. Belden automation products and solutions are sold directly to industrial equipment OEMs and through a network of distributors, value-added resellers and system integrators for broader reach. See Note 5 to the Consolidated Financial Statements for additional information regarding our segments.

A key part of our business strategy includes acquiring companies to support our growth and enhance our product portfolio. Our acquisition strategy is based on targeting leading companies that offer innovative products that complement our existing solutions and strong brands. We utilize a disciplined approach to acquisitions based on product and market opportunities. When we identify acquisition candidates, we conduct rigorous financial and cultural analyses to make certain that they meet both our strategic plan targets and our goal for return on invested capital.

We have completed a number of acquisitions in recent years as part of this strategy. In September 2024, we acquired Voleatech GmbH (Voleatech) which is known for its VT AIR Next Gen Firewall and will expand Belden's Firewall product portfolio and overall planning of security in OT networking. In June 2024, we acquired Precision Optical Technologies (Precision), a leading supplier of value-added optical transceivers with proprietary software, firmware configurations, and related components. In August 2023, we acquired CloudRail GmbH (CloudRail), which specializes in sensor to cloud data solutions allowing end users to quickly connect sensors on their machinery to cloud providers to drive business insights and improve outcomes. In April 2023, we acquired Berthold Sichert GmbH (Sichert), which designs and manufactures a portfolio of polycarbonate street cabinets utilized in outside plant passive optical networks ("PON") and 5G networks. The results of Precision and Sichert have been included in our Consolidated Financial Statements from their respective acquisition dates and are reported within the Smart Infrastructure Solutions segment. The results of Voleatech and CloudRail have been included in our Consolidated Financial Statements from their respective acquisition dates and are reported within the Automation Solutions segment. For more information regarding our most recent transactions, see Note 4 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

We sell to distributors, OEMs, installers, and end-users. For the year ended December 31, 2025, sales to our largest distributor represented approximately 14% of our consolidated revenues. No other customer accounted for more than 10% of our revenues in 2025.

We have supply agreements with distributors and OEM customers. In general, our customers are not contractually obligated to buy our products exclusively, in minimum amounts, or for a significant period of time. We believe that our relationships with our customers and distributors are good and that they are loyal to Belden products as a result of our reputation, the breadth of our product portfolio, the quality and performance characteristics of our products, and our customer service and technical support, among other reasons.

In addition to manufacturing facilities in the United States (U.S.), we have manufacturing and other operating facilities in Canada, China, India, Mexico, and Tunisia, as well as various countries in Europe. During 2025, approximately 42% of Belden's sales were to customers outside the U.S. Our primary channels to international markets include both distributors and direct sales to end users and OEMs. Financial information for Belden by country is shown in Note 6 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

The markets in which we operate can be generally categorized as highly competitive with many players. In order to maximize our competitive advantages, we manage our product portfolio to capitalize on secular trends and high-growth applications in those markets. Based on available data for our served markets, we estimate that our market share across our segments ranges from approximately 5% to 15%. Substantial share capture or a significant acquisition in one of our served markets would be necessary to meaningfully change our estimated market share percentage.

headings: Business and Operational Risks
Cyber security incidents have and could in the future interfere with our business and operations.
Volatility in global trade policies and practices could have direct and indirect impacts on our business.
Our results of operations are subject to foreign and domestic political, social, economic, and other uncertainties and are affected by changes in currency exchange rates.
Our future success depends in part on our ability to develop and introduce new products and respond to changes in customer preferences.
Our ability to remain competitive will be determined, in part, by our ability to successfully implement AI into our product offerings and back office processes.

Our reliance on legacy information technology systems and the challenges associated with their maintenance and upgrade could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
The global markets in which we operate are highly competitive.
A challenging global economic environment or a downturn in the markets we serve could adversely affect our operating results and stock price in a material manner.
We may have difficulty integrating the operations of acquired businesses, which could negatively affect our results of operations, profitability, and achievement of our strategic plan.
We may be unable to achieve our goals related to revenue growth.
Our revenue for any particular period can be difficult to forecast.
We may be unable to implement our strategic plan successfully.
We may experience significant variability in our quarterly and annual effective tax rate which would affect our reported net income.
If we are unable to attract and retain key employees, our business operations could be adversely affected.
Our revenue and profits would likely decline, at least temporarily, if we were to lose a key distributor.
Actions of activists could cause us to incur substantial costs, divert management's attention and resources, and have an adverse effect on our business.
Perceived failure of our data solutions to provide expected results may result in negative publicity and harm our business and operating results.
General Industry and Economic Risks
Inflation and changes in the price and availability of raw materials may lead to higher input and labor costs in a way that could be detrimental to our profitability.
Extreme weather events and other climate-related catastrophes could impact our locations, our people and our performance.
Future epidemics, pandemics or other major disasters could impact our future results of operations and overall financial performance.
Volatility of credit markets and rising interest rates could adversely affect our business.
We may be unable to achieve our strategic priorities in emerging markets.
Legal and Regulatory Risks
Changes in global tariffs and trade agreements may have a negative impact on global economic conditions, markets and our business.
Changes in tax laws may adversely affect our financial position.
We are subject to laws and regulations worldwide, changes to which could increase our costs and individually or in the aggregate adversely affect our business.
Increasing expectations with respect to Sustainability matters by our various stakeholders and Sustainability regulation could adversely affect our business and operating results.
We might have difficulty protecting our intellectual property from use by competitors, or competitors might accuse us of violating their intellectual property rights.
Our use of open source software could negatively impact our ability to sell our products and may subject us to unanticipated obligations.
If our goodwill or other intangible assets become impaired, we would be required to recognize charges that would reduce our income.
Some of our employees are members of collective bargaining groups, and we might be subject to labor actions that would interrupt our business.
paragraphs: Following is a discussion of some of the more significant risks that could materially impact our business. There may be additional risks that impact our business that we currently do not recognize as, or that are not currently, material to our business.

Computer hacking, malware, phishing, and spamming attacks against online networking platforms have become more prevalent, more recently enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence ("AI") tools. Though it is difficult to determine what, if any, harm may directly result from any specific attack or interruption, such events could also be expensive to remedy, harm our reputation or brands, and/or lead users to lose trust and confidence in our business. We, and others on our behalf, also have possession of "personally identifiable information" ("PII") with respect to employees, vendors, customers, and others. Based upon a past incident, we have implemented safeguards to protect the privacy of PII as it is possible that hackers or others might obtain this information. We may be subject to potentially costly remedial actions, fines, penalties, lawsuits, and reputational damage in the event of a future incident.

Throughout 2025, the United States government issued orders increasing tariffs on imports from nearly every country in the world on certain products. In some cases, this has led to negotiations of new trade deals and in others, it has resulted in reciprocal tariffs on U.S. exports. Because not all goods can be sourced in all countries, global companies like Belden will experience increased costs in their supply chains that may lead to reduced margins or increased prices. These increased costs and the uncertainty during transition periods could lead to changes in buying behavior, such as decreased demand. These impacts could have a negative effect on our financial results, including our revenue, gross margins, and profitability.

Supply chain issues, including scarcity of raw materials or other components necessary to produce the products we manufacture, could increase costs or cause a delay in our ability to fulfill orders, and could adversely affect our future results of operations and our overall financial performance.

The Company relies on an extended supply chain and the availability of certain raw materials, including but not limited to copper, to produce a significant amount of our products. A reduction or interruption in supply, an inability to procure quality raw materials in a cost-effective manner and constrain volatile materials costs, a failure to monitor contract compliance to ensure and sustain sourcing savings, a failure to procure adequate inventory or raw materials from our suppliers, or regulatory changes may lead to delays in manufacturing and increases in costs.

Many components, including those that are available from multiple sources, are at times subject to industry-wide shortages that could materially adversely affect the Company's financial condition and operating results. While the Company has entered into agreements for the supply of many components, there can be no assurance that the Company will be able to extend or renew these agreements on similar terms, or at all. Component suppliers may suffer from poor financial conditions, which can lead to business failure for the supplier or consolidation within a particular industry, further limiting the Company's ability to obtain sufficient quantities of components on commercially reasonable terms. Restrictions on the free movement of goods, like tariffs or sanctions regimes, or health crises, such as a pandemic, could impact the regular availability or cost of important components. If the Company's supply of components for a new or existing product were delayed or constrained, or if an outsourcing partner delayed shipments of completed products to the Company, the Company's financial condition and operating results could be materially adversely affected. The Company's business and financial performance could also be materially adversely affected depending on the time required to obtain sufficient quantities from the original source, or to identify and obtain sufficient quantities from an alternative source. Similarly, if the Company's customers experience production challenges due to the inability to obtain certain components, this may negatively impact the customers' ordering patterns from the Company.

paragraphs: Belden is a leading global supplier of complete connection solutions that unlock untold possibilities for our customers, their customers and the world. We advance ideas and technologies that enable a safer, smarter and more prosperous future. Throughout our 120-plus year history we have evolved as a company, but making connections remains our purpose. By connecting people, information and ideas, we make it possible.
Our long-term business goals are to: •Achieve mid-single-digit annual revenue growth; •Deliver incremental Adjusted EBITDA margins between 25% to 30%;
•Generate free cash flow margin approaching 10%;
•Execute a disciplined capital allocation strategy while maintaining net leverage around 1.5x; and
•Strive for annual Adjusted EPS growth of 10% to 12%.
The following trends and events during 2025 had varying effects on our financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows.

Our exposure to currency rate fluctuations primarily relates to exchange rate movements between the U.S. dollar and the euro, Canadian dollar, Hong Kong dollar, Chinese yuan, Mexican peso, Australian dollar, British pound, and Indian rupee. Generally, as the U.S. dollar strengthens against these foreign currencies, our revenues and earnings are negatively impacted as our foreign denominated revenues and earnings are translated into U.S. dollars at a lower rate. Conversely, as the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, our revenues and earnings are positively impacted. Because all of our senior subordinated notes are denominated in euros, interest expense on the notes is affected by exchange rate movements between the U.S. dollar and the euro.

In addition to the translation impact described above, currency rate fluctuations have an economic impact on our financial results. As the U.S. dollar strengthens or weakens against foreign currencies, it results in a relative price increase or decrease for certain of our products that are priced in U.S. dollars in a foreign location.

Our operating results can be affected by changes in prices of commodities, primarily copper and compounds, which are components in some of the products we sell. Generally, as the costs of inventory purchases increase due to higher commodity prices, we raise selling prices to customers to cover the increase in costs, resulting in higher sales revenue but a lower gross profit percentage. Conversely, a decrease in commodity prices would result in lower sales revenue but a higher gross profit percentage. Selling prices of our products are affected by many factors, including end market demand, capacity utilization, overall economic conditions, and commodity prices. Importantly, however, there is no exact measure of the effect of changing commodity prices, as there are thousands of transactions in any given quarter, each of which has various factors involved in the individual pricing decisions. Therefore, all references to the effect of copper prices or other commodity prices are estimates.

Our operating results also can be affected by the levels of Belden products purchased and held as inventory by our channel partners and customers. Our channel partners and customers purchase and hold our products in their inventory in order to meet the service and on-time delivery requirements of their customers. Generally, as our channel partners and customers change the level of Belden products owned and held in their inventory, it impacts our revenues. Comparisons of our results between periods can be impacted by changes in the levels of channel inventory. We are dependent upon our channel partners to provide us with information regarding the amount of our products that they own and hold in their inventory. As such, all references to the effect of channel inventory changes are estimates.

The markets in which we operate can generally be characterized as highly competitive and highly fragmented, with many players. Based on available data for our served markets, we estimate that our market share across our segments is significant, ranging from approximately 5% – 15%. A substantial acquisition in one of our served markets would be necessary to meaningfully change our estimated market share percentage. We monitor available data regarding market growth, including independent market research reports, publicly available indices, and the financial results of our direct and indirect peer companies, in order to estimate the extent to which our served markets grew or contracted during a particular period. We generally expect that our unit sales volume will increase or decrease consistently with the market growth rate. Our strategic goal is to transition to a solutions provider and target faster growing geographies, applications, and trends within our end markets, in order to achieve growth that is higher than the general market growth rate. To the extent that we exceed the market growth rates, we consider it to be the result of capturing market share.

During periods of inflation, if we are unable to raise prices timely and sufficiently to recover our material costs, our earnings could decline. Furthermore, inflation may impact labor, energy, and other costs. We monitor inflation pressures and proactively implement selling price increases and cost control measures as appropriate.
During 2025, we repurchased 1.7 million shares of our common stock for an aggregate cost of $194.6 million at an average price per share of $113.00. See Note 21.

paragraphs: Belden Inc. (the Company, us, we, or our) 為全球領先的零組件供應商，提供完整的連接解決方案，為客戶、客戶的客戶以及世界創造無限可能。我們推動想法與技術，以實現更安全、更智慧且更繁榮的未來。在本公司超過 120 年的歷史中，我們持續進化，但建立連接始終是我們的使命。我們的業務以兩個全球性業務為核心，Smart Infrastructure Solutions 與 Automation Solutions，這兩個業務均受益於有利的長期趨勢，我們預期這些趨勢將驅動未來的成長。每個業務均為應報告分部。關於我們分部的財務資訊，請參閱財務報表附註 5。我們將產品銷售給經銷商、最終用戶、安裝商，以及直接銷售給原廠設備製造商 (OEMs)。Belden Inc. 為設立於 1988 年的德拉瓦州公司，但本公司歷史可追溯至 1902 年 Joseph Belden 成立的起源。
如本文所用，除非有特定營運分部被識別或上下文另有要求，"Belden"、"the Company" 以及 "we" 均指 Belden Inc. 及其子公司整體。

我們的使命是建立連接。在 Smart Infrastructure Solutions 中，我們的 Smart Buildings 產品提供室內有線與無線基礎設施、光纖技術創新、設計協作與客製化，以創新解決方案連接人與設施，提升人際互動、生產力與安全性。同時在 Smart Infrastructure Solutions 中，我們的 Broadband Solutions 產品提供廣泛的端到端解決方案、行業領先的創新與技術，以及全球技術服務與支援，以實現透過寬頻與無線創新連結的數位世界。在 Automation Solutions 中，我們獨具優勢，可支持數位轉型，提供端到端的數位化基礎設施，專注於強固的網路基礎設施、安全的遠端存取、資訊科技系統與運營科技 (IT/OT) 的快速融合，以及邊緣與數據分析。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們以兩個分部運作 – Smart Infrastructure Solutions 與 Automation Solutions。關於這些分部的說明請參閱下文。2026 年，我們將重新調整組織結構，轉為統一的功能性營運模式。請參閱附註 25。

Smart Infrastructure Solutions 分部為網路基礎設施與寬頻解決方案的領先供應商。我們 Smart Buildings 解決方案的重點垂直市場包括資料中心、政府、醫療與旅館業。我們也服務商業不動產、教育、金融機構、體育場館與場地，以及軍事設施等市場。我們的 Broadband 解決方案主要服務寬頻與無線服務供應商。Smart Infrastructure Solutions 的產品線包括銅線電纜與連接解決方案、光纖電纜與連接解決方案、接線面板、機架與機櫃，以及安全、高性能的訊號延伸與矩陣切換系統。

Smart Infrastructure Solutions 提供完整的端到端光纖與銅線網路系統，應用於區域網路、資料中心、存取控制、5G、光纖到家 (Fiber to the Home)、商業音影片、安全與建築自動化等場景。我們的高性能解決方案支援所有網路協議，包括 100G+ 乙太網路技術。我們的創新產品可同時傳輸數據與電力，符合智慧建築中連接數量增加所驅動的更高性能需求。Smart Infrastructure Solutions 的產品也包括智慧電力、冷卻與風流通風管理，用以支援關鍵任務資料中心的運作。產品組合設計用以支援客戶的網路協議整合、無線通訊使用率增加與雲端資料中心。
Belden 的 Automation Solutions 分部提供數位化與自動化解決方案，作為 IT/OT 融合的基礎元件，包括實體 AI，應用於嚴苛的垂直市場。這使我們的客戶能做出基於數據的商業決策。我們透過提供完整的連接解決方案加速數位轉型，涵蓋數據處理的四個方面：資料取得、傳輸、協調與管理。我們的主要市場包括倉儲與物流、能源、運輸與離散製造。

我們協助客戶提高運作時間，並確保網路數據的可用性、完整性與機密性。我們瞭解客戶的運作、品質、安全與創新需求，並透過善用即時運作數據，協助客戶成功。我們全球的工程師與顧問團隊在客戶創新中心直接與客戶合作，瞭解運作問題、預測成功結果所需的條件，並解決獨特的網路需求。Belden 的自動化產品與解決方案直接銷售給工業設備 OEMs，並透過經銷商、增值經銷商與系統整合商的網路擴大市場覆蓋範圍。有關我們分部的更多資訊，請參閱財務報表附註 5。
本公司業務策略的重要部分包含取得公司以支持成長並強化產品組合。本公司取得策略係基於尋找提供創新產品且能與本公司現有解決方案互補，且擁有強大品牌的領導公司。本公司採用嚴謹的取得方式，基於產品與市場機會。當本公司識別出取得目標時，會進行嚴謹的財務與文化分析，以確保其符合本公司策略計畫目標與對投資資本回報率的目標。

本公司已於近年完成多項取得，作為此策略的一部分。2024年9月，本公司取得Voleatech GmbH（Voleatech），該公司以VT AIR Next Gen Firewall聞名，將擴充Belden的防火牆產品組合與整體OT網路安全規劃。2024年6月，本公司取得Precision Optical Technologies（Precision），為價值增加光學轉接器的主要供應商，擁有專屬軟體、固件設定與相關零組件。2023年8月，本公司取得CloudRail GmbH（CloudRail），專門從事感測器至雲端資料解決方案，使終端用戶能迅速將其機械上的感測器連接到雲端供應商，以驅動業務洞察並改善結果。2023年4月，本公司取得Berthold Sichert GmbH（Sichert），設計與製造用於室外光纖無源光網路（"PON"）與5G網路的聚碳酸酯街頭機櫃組合。Precision與Sichert的結果自其取得日已納入本公司合併財務報表，並歸屬於Smart Infrastructure Solutions應報告分部。Voleatech與CloudRail的結果自其取得日已納入本公司合併財務報表，並歸屬於Automation Solutions應報告分部。如需更多有關本公司最近交易的資訊，請參閱合併財務報表的附註4。
本公司銷售對象為經銷商、OEM、安裝商與終端用戶。2025年12月31日財年，銷售至本公司最大經銷商約佔本公司合併營業收入的14%。2025年，無其他客戶佔據超過10%的營業收入。
本公司與經銷商與OEM客戶有供應協議。通常，客戶並無契約義務必須獨家購買本公司產品、最低購買數量或長時間購買。本公司認為與客戶與經銷商的關係良好，他們對Belden產品的忠誠度係因本公司聲譽、產品組合的廣度、產品的品質與性能特徵，以及客戶服務與技術支援等多種因素所致。
除了美國（U.S.）的製造廠外，本公司在加拿大、中國、印度、墨西哥與突尼西亞，以及歐洲各國設有製造與其他營運設施。2025年，Belden約42%的銷售為銷售至美國以外的客戶。本公司進入國際市場的主要通路為經銷商與直接銷售至終端用戶與OEM。有關Belden按國家分列的財務資訊，請參閱合併財務報表的附註6。
本公司營運的市場可歸納為高度競爭，參與者眾多。為最大化本公司競爭優勢，本公司管理產品組合以把握長期趨勢與高成長應用。根據本公司服務市場的可用資料，我們估計本公司各應報告分部的市場佔有率約為5%至15%之間。要顯著改變我們估計的市場佔有率百分比，必須在某個服務市場進行大量市場佔有或重大取得。

paragraphs: Belden 為全球領先的供應商，提供完整的連接解決方案，為客戶、客戶的客戶以及世界帶來無限可能。我們推動想法與技術，以實現更安全、更智慧且更繁榮的未來。在超過 120 年的歷史中，我們的公司不斷進化，但建立連接始終是我們的使命。透過連接人們、資訊與想法，我們讓這一切成為可能。
我們的長期營運目標為：•達成年營業收入中位數成長率為單位數；•提供調整後營業利益率在 25% 到 30% 之間的增量；
•產生接近 10% 的自由現金流率；
•執行嚴謹的資本配置策略，同時維持淨負債約為 1.5 倍；以及
•追求年調整後每股盈餘成長率為 10% 到 12%。
2025 年期間，我們面臨的趨勢與事件對我們的財務狀況、營運結果與現金流產生了不同程度的影響。

我們對匯率波動的敞口主要與美國美元與歐元、加拿大幣、港幣、人民幣、墨西哥幣、澳洲幣、英鎊與印度盧比之間的匯率變動有關。通常而言，當美國美元對這些外幣升值時，我們的營收與獲利會受到負面影響，因為我們以外幣計價的營收與獲利在轉換為美國美元時，會以較低的匯率計算。相反地，當美國美元對外幣貶值時，我們的營收與獲利會受到正面影響。由於我們所有高階次級優先無擔保債券均以歐元計價，因此這些債券的利息支出會受到美國美元與歐元之間匯率變動的影響。
除了上述的匯率變動所產生的轉換影響外，匯率波動也會對我們的財務結果產生經濟影響。當美國美元對外幣升值或貶值時，會導致我們某些以美國美元計價的產品在海外市場的相對價格上升或下降。

本公司營運成果可能受商品價格變動影響，主要為銅與其化合物，這些是我們部分產品的零組件。通常，當庫存採購成本因商品價格上漲而提高時，我們會提高對客戶的銷售價格以彌補成本增加，導致銷售收入增加但毛利率百分比降低。相反地，商品價格下降將導致銷售收入減少但毛利率百分比提高。我們產品的銷售價格受多種因素影響，包括終端市場需求、產能利用率、總體經濟狀況及商品價格。然而，重要的是，並沒有確切的衡量方式能準確反映商品價格變動的影響，因為每個季度都有數千筆交易，每筆交易在個別定價決策時都涉及不同的因素。因此，所有關於銅價或其他商品價格變動的參考皆為估計。

本公司營運成果也可能受我們通路夥伴與客戶所持有庫存中的 Belden 產品數量影響。通路夥伴與客戶會購買並持有我們的產品庫存，以符合其客戶的服務與準時交貨需求。通常，當通路夥伴與客戶改變所持有 Belden 產品的庫存量時，會影響我們的收入。我們不同期間的營運成果比較可能受通路庫存變動影響。我們依賴通路夥伴提供我們有關其庫存中所持有我們產品數量的資訊。因此，所有關於通路庫存變動影響的參考皆為估計。

我們所經營的市場通常可歸納為高度競爭且高度分散，參與者眾多。根據我們所服務市場的可用資料，我們估計在各個應報告分部的市場佔有率為顯著，範圍約為 5% 至 15%。要顯著改變我們的市場佔有率百分比，必須在所服務市場進行重大收購。我們會監測可用的市場成長資料，包括獨立市場研究報告、公開指標以及我們直接與間接競爭公司的財務結果，以估計我們所服務市場在特定期間的成長或衰退程度。我們通常預期，我們的單元銷售量將與市場成長率一致地增加或減少。我們的戰略目標是轉型為解決方案供應商，並針對我們終端市場中成長較快的地理區域、應用領域與趨勢，以實現高於一般市場成長率的成長。若我們的成長率超過市場成長率，我們認為這是因為我們成功取得市場佔有率。
在通貨膨脹期間，若我們無法及時且足夠地提高價格以彌補材料成本，我們的獲利可能會下降。此外，通貨膨脹可能影響勞動力、能源及其他成本。我們會監測通貨膨脹壓力，並根據需要積極實施銷售價格上漲與成本控制措施。

headings: Business and Operational Risks
網路安全事件已並可能於未來幹擾本公司之業務與運作。
全球貿易政策與實務之波動可能對本公司業務產生直接與間接影響。
本公司之營運成果受外國與國內政治、社會、經濟及其他不確定因素影響，並受匯率變動之影響。
本公司未來之成功在一定程度上取決於本公司開發與推出新產品並回應客戶偏好變動之能力。
本公司維持競爭力之能力將在一定程度上取決於本公司成功將人工智能導入產品組合與後臺流程之能力。
本公司對遺留資訊科技系統之依賴及其維護與升級所面臨之挑戰，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司所從事之全球市場具有高度競爭性。
一個困難的全球經濟環境或所服務市場出現衰退，可能會在重大程度上不利於我們的營運成果與股票價格。
我們可能難以整合收購公司的營運，這可能會對我們的營運成果、獲利能力及戰略計畫的達成產生負面影響。
我們可能無法實現與營收成長相關的目標。
我們在任何特定期間的營收可能難以預測。
我們可能無法成功執行我們的戰略計畫。
我們可能面臨季度與年度有效稅率的重大變動，這將影響我們報告的淨收入。
如果我們無法吸引並留住關鍵員工，我們的營運可能會受到不利影響。
如果我們失去關鍵經銷商，我們的營收與獲利將可能至少暫時下降。
activism 行動可能導致本公司產生重大成本，分散管理階層的注意力與資源，並對本公司業務產生不利影響。
若市場認為本公司資料解決方案未能達成預期成效，可能導致負面宣傳，並損害本公司業務與營運成果。
一般產業與經濟風險
通貨膨脹及原物料價格與可得性的變動，可能導致輸入與勞動成本上升，進而對本公司獲利能力產生不利影響。
極端天氣事件及其他與氣候相關的災難，可能影響本公司營運據點、員工及營運表現。
未來可能發生的疫情、大規模流行病或其他重大災難，可能影響本公司未來營運成果與整體財務表現。
信用市場波動及利率上升，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司可能無法在新興市場達成戰略優先目標。
法律及法規風險
全球關稅與貿易協議的變動可能對全球經濟狀況、市場及我們的業務產生負面影響。
稅法的變動可能對我們的財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們在全球各國皆受法律與法規所規範，相關法規的變動可能增加我們的成本，並個別或整體對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們各項利害關係人對永續發展議題的期待不斷提高，以及永續發展相關法規的強化，可能對我們的業務與營運成果產生不利影響。
我們可能難以保護智慧財產權不被競爭對手使用，或競爭對手可能指控我們違反其智慧財產權權利。
我們使用開源軟體可能對我們銷售產品的能力產生負面影響，並可能使我們面臨未預期的義務。
若我們的商譽或其他無形資產發生減損，我們將必須認列減損費用，此將降低我們的營業收入。
本公司部分員工為集體談判團體成員，且本公司可能面臨勞動爭議，導致營運中斷
paragraphs: 以下為一些可能對我們業務產生重大影響的風險討論。可能尚有其他風險影響我們的業務，而我們目前尚未認定其為重大或尚未發生。

針對線上網路平台的電腦駭客攻擊、惡意軟體、釣魚攻擊及垃圾郵件攻擊已變得更加普遍，近期更因人工智慧（"AI"）工具的應用而更加嚴重。雖然很難判斷任何特定攻擊或中斷是否會直接造成什麼損害，但這些事件也可能導致高昂的修復成本、損害我們的聲譽或品牌，並/或使用戶對我們的業務失去信任與信心。我們，以及我們代表的其他人，也持有關於員工、供應商、客戶及其他人的"個人可識別資訊"（"PII"）。根據過去的事件，我們已實施保護措施以維護PII的隱私，因為有可能駭客或其他人會取得此資訊。若發生未來事件，我們可能面臨高昂的補救措施、罰款、處罰、訴訟及聲譽損害。

2025年全年，美國政府發布了增加進口關稅的命令，針對來自全球幾乎每個國家的特定產品。在某些情況下，這導致了新的貿易協議的談判，而在其他情況下，則導致對美國出口的報復性關稅。因為並非所有商品都能在所有國家取得，像Belden這樣的全球公司將在其供應鏈中經歷成本增加，這可能會導致利潤率下降或價格上漲。這些成本增加以及過渡期的不確定性，可能會導致買方行為的改變，例如需求減少。這些影響可能對我們的財務結果產生負面影響，包括我們的營業收入、毛利率及利潤率。
供應鏈問題，包括生產我們製造的產品所必需的原材料或其他零組件的短缺，可能會增加成本或導致我們履行訂單的能力延遲，並可能對我們未來的營運結果及整體財務表現產生不利影響。
本公司依賴延展性的供應鏈，以及某些原材料的可取得性，包括但不限於銅，以製造我們大量產品。供應減少或中斷、無法以具成本效益的方式取得品質良好的原材料、面對材料價格波動、未能監測契約履行以確保並維持採購節省、未能從供應商處取得足夠的存貨或原材料、或法規變更，都可能導致製造延遲及成本增加。

許多零組件，包括那些可從多個來源取得的零組件，有時會受到行業範圍內的短缺影響，這可能會對本公司的財務狀況及營運結果產生重大不利影響。雖然本公司已與許多零組件的供應商簽訂供應協議，但無法保證本公司將能以相似條件或任何條件延長或續約這些協議。零組件供應商可能面臨財務狀況不佳，這可能會導致供應商業務失敗或產業內的併購，進一步限制本公司以商業上合理的條件取得足夠零組件的能力。對商品自由流通的限制，例如關稅或制裁制度，或健康危機，例如疫情，可能會影響重要零組件的正常取得或成本。若本公司新產品或現有產品的零組件供應延遲或受到限制，或若委外夥伴延遲將完成產品運送至本公司，則本公司財務狀況及營運結果可能受到重大不利影響。本公司業務及財務表現也可能根據從原廠取得足夠數量所需時間，或尋找並取得足夠數量替代來源所需時間而受到重大不利影響。同樣地，若本公司客戶因無法取得特定零組件而遭遇生產困難，這可能會對客戶從本公司訂購的模式產生負面影響。
